title: Test Execution and Security Limits
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Test Execution and Security Limits.

concepts_covered: Tests cover local command execution, failures, retries, timeout, results, and final tasks; they do not prove a sandbox.
Host command execution uses exec.CommandContext with the caller's OS permissions; tests use a recording executor for safe cases.
